RENT AGREEMENT
This Rent Agreement is made on 25/03/2024 at Harinagar.
Landlord: Anita Sharma, W/o Vinod Sharma, R/o 12 Civil Lines, Harinagar.
Tenant: Deepak Joshi, S/o Harish Joshi, R/o 9 Station Road, Harinagar.
Premises: Property Address: House on Plot No. 17, Block C, Lakshmi Nagar Extension,
Harinagar.
1. The period of this agreement is 3 years, commencing from 01/04/2024.
2. The tenant shall pay a monthly rent of Rs. 18,000/- on or before the 7th of each month.
3. The tenant has paid a security deposit of Rs. 36,000/-, refundable on vacating.
4. Either party may end this agreement by giving one month's written notice.
